def factor_liquidity_overnight_intraday_flow_smooth10(df):
    """Overnight-intraday divergence amplified by relative volume, smoothed over a longer 10-day window to reduce single-day noise and drawdown spikes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    divergence = overnight_ret - intraday_ret
    signal = divergence * vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    factor = signal.rolling(10, min_periods=5).mean()
    df_copy["factor_liquidity_overnight_intraday_flow_smooth10"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_liquidity_overnight_intraday_flow_smooth10"]
description: Preserves the parent's overnight-intraday liquidity divergence mechanism. The mutation increases the smoothing window from 5 to 10 days to reduce the influence of transient liquidity shocks and lower turnover/drawdown, targeting robustness (ICIR/RankICIR) while preserving the core direction and relative volume confirmation. Cross-sectional z-score is kept because overnight-intraday divergence magnitude varies across assets and relative comparison is economically meaningful.
